name: labs/thedeanlab__navigate
title: ASI MS-2000 motorised stage (navigate.MS2000Stage)
intro: ASI MS-2000 motorised stage (navigate.MS2000Stage), adapted from thedeanlab/navigate. It reads `x_position`, `y_position` and `z_position`; runs `move_axis_absolute` and `stop_scan`. `move_axis_absolute`: move one stage axis to an absolute position in micrometres. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/thedeanlab__navigate --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/thedeanlab__navigate --backend fake --mcp
